name: concierge-scripts
description: Shortcuts for the concierge packages. Not a workspace package: run these from this folder (pnpm check, pnpm dev). The H1 monorepo's turbo tasks (typecheck, test, build) already include the @concierge/* packages.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @concierge/backend check:logging && pnpm --filter @concierge/backend check:configs && pnpm --filter @concierge/widget build
